# Support FAQ (draft)

Owner: Jonah · Draft for review · 2026-09-15

**Does Quillwend work without internet?**
Yes. Everything works offline. Changes sync the next time the device is online.

**Can I use it on more than one device?**
Yes. Pair a new device with a code from a device you already use.

**What happens if I lose my phone?**
Your journal is still on your other devices. If it was your only device, you need your recovery
code.

**Can I export my data?**
CSV export is planned for after the first public release.

**How do refunds work?**
See the refund policy document in the support folder.

**How do I contact support?**
Email support@nimbrel.example. We answer on working days.
